svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Door: 172 x 526 x 2 mm plate; round the corners 3 mm.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Pull handle on the front, 45 to 70 mm right of the door centre,

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 243 to 283 mm up from the door's bottom edge.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Lock tongue: a 4 mm steel angle riveted to the back; its tongue

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: stands 21 mm back, 50 to 54 mm right of centre, 253 to 273 mm

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: up, with a 6 mm hole for the lock bolt.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Hinge: a stainless piano hinge 480 mm long, riveted to the door's

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: front face along its left edge and to the front panel beside it.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Gasket: 7 x 3 mm closed-cell EPDM strip stuck to the panel round

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: the opening, 1 mm out from its edge.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Blank plate: the same 172 x 526 plate with four 5.5 mm holes

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: for M5 security screws into rivet nuts in the panel.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: the door closes on the gasket evenly, tongue in the lock.
